stem: Given g(x) = x^2 - 6x - 16, which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: The zeros are -8 and 2, because the factors of g are (x + 8) and (x - 2).

options.label: G
options.text: The zeros are -8 and -2, because the factors of g are (x + 8) and (x + 2).

options.label: H
options.text: The zeros are -2 and 8, because the factors of g are (x + 2) and (x - 8).

options.label: J
options.text: The zeros are 2 and 8, because the factors of g are (x - 2) and (x - 8).
